visual_action: A slideshow of two still photos. The first is of Kevin McCarthy looking serious, and the second is of Jim Jordan, also with a serious expression. Both photos have text overlays about losing a vote for speakership.

cast.name: Kevin McCarthy
cast.evidence: A photo of him is shown with the text 'lost the first vote for the speakership', referring to his January 2023 speakership election.

cast.name: Jim Jordan
cast.evidence: A photo of him is shown with the text 'also lost the first vote for the speakership 🤡', referring to his October 2023 speakership election.

on_screen_text.text: lost the first vote for the speakership
also lost the first vote for the speakership 🤡

spoken_summary: The audio contains lyrics from the background song, including ad-libs like 'Day you know' and 'This the remix'.
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat pop/R&B song 'Say So (China Remix)' by Doja Cat. The jaunty tone of the music creates a mocking effect when paired with the images of politicians' failures.
editing_pacing: A simple slideshow with one cut between two static images.
cultural_references: The song 'Say So' by Doja Cat, which was a major viral trend on TikTok.
central_claim: Republican leaders Kevin McCarthy and Jim Jordan are being mocked for both failing on their first votes to become Speaker of the House, implying Republican party disfunction.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock the Republican party's leadership struggles and perceive them as incompetent.
